시편-77-1.title: 시편 77장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-77-1.exegesis: 11-12. Invite homage to such a God ( 2Ch 32:23 ), who can stop the breath of kings and princes when He wills ( Da 5:23 ).

시편-77-2.title: 시편 77장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-77-2.exegesis: PSALM 77 Psa 77:1-20 . To Jeduthun--(See on Psa 39:1 , title). In a time of great affliction, when ready to despair, the Psalmist derives relief from calling to mind God's former and wonderful works of delivering power and grace. 1. expresses the purport of the Psalm.

시편-77-11.title: 시편 77장 11절 역사문법적 주해
시편-77-11.exegesis: 10. Omitting the supplied words, we may read, "This is my affliction-- the years of," &c., "years" being taken as parallel to affliction (compare Psa 90:15 ), as of God's ordering.

시편-77-12.title: 시편 77장 12절 역사문법적 주해
시편-77-12.exegesis: 11-12. He finds relief in contrasting God's former deliverances. Shall we receive good at His hands, and not evil? Both are orderings of unerring mercy and unfailing love.
시편-77-12.theologicalNote: 11-12. He finds relief in contrasting God's former deliverances. Shall we receive good at His hands, and not evil? Both are orderings of unerring mercy and unfailing love.

시편-77-14.title: 시편 77장 14절 역사문법적 주해
시편-77-14.exegesis: 13. Thy way ... in the sanctuary-- God's ways of grace and providence ( Psa 22:3 ; 67:2 ), ordered on holy principles, as developed in His worship; or implied in His perfections, if "holiness" be used for "sanctuary," as some prefer translating (compare Ex 15:11 ).

시편-77-15.title: 시편 77장 15절 역사문법적 주해
시편-77-15.exegesis: 14-20. Illustrations of God's power in His special interventions for His people ( Ex 14:1-31 ), and, in the more common, but sublime, control of nature ( Psa 22:11-14 ; Ha 3:14 ) which may have attended those miraculous events ( Ex 14:24 ).
